name: [Portal] Partner schema fix-ups: category icon, region lookup, field nullability (DB)
description:
### Summary

Comparing the tables CZ3TDR1-572 shipped (`database/schema/st_crm.sql`, `partner` L2438, `partner_category_lng` L2488) against `partners_web/contract/openapi.yaml` surfaces three mismatches that will block a faithful public API.

### Why?

1. `Category.iconSlug` (icon file name, nullable) has no column on `partner_category_lng` — the professionals-landing category icons have nowhere to come from.
2. `partner.region` is a free `varchar(255)`, but `/professionals/regions` needs a `RegionGroup` per country with a stable `id`/`name`/`count` — i.e. a real lookup table, not free text.
3. `partner.verifiedLevel` and `partner.cin` are `NOT NULL` in the DB but the contract defines both as nullable (`verifiedLevel`: null for partners without a verified level; `cin`: nullable IČO).

### What?

A follow-up migration set: add the missing column, introduce a `partner_region` lookup table with `partner.region` becoming a FK to it, and relax the two columns to nullable.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `partner_category_lng.iconSlug varchar(255) NULL` added, `ALGORITHM=INSTANT`
- [ ] `partner_region` table created (`id`, `name`, `countryId`); `partner.region` converted to a FK pointing at it — no data backfill needed, no production data exists yet since the portal hasn't launched
- [ ] `partner.verifiedLevel` and `partner.cin` relaxed to nullable, `ALGORITHM=INPLACE`
- [ ] Migration under `migrations/2026/devrel/crm/CZ3TDR1-673/`, `make lint-migrations` passes
- [ ] Flagged to whoever picks up CZ3TDR1-674 (partner domain layer), since it touches columns that task's read model/DTOs will use

### Resources

- Epic: CZ3TDR1-614
- Depends on: CZ3TDR1-572
- Blocks/informs: CZ3TDR1-674 and the category-domain / public-API tasks filed alongside this one
